daily_brief: The transatlantic relationship faced new strain Friday as the EU 'fully rejected' US threats to ban diesel exports unless Europe releases strategic fuel reserves, a move tied to soaring energy prices from the ongoing US-Iran conflict ahead of November midterms [France 24, Globe and Mail, Financial Times]. The crisis comes as Washington deploys a third aircraft carrier strike group to the Middle East, with up to 10,000 additional troops heading to the region [Al Jazeera]. In Europe, France closed 400 schools amid escalating student protests over education funding that have injured hundreds and led to nearly 2,000 arrests [BBC, RFI]. Russia's President Putin issued stark warnings that Moscow would use 'all weapons' to protect Kaliningrad if NATO attempted any blockade, as hybrid warfare incidents surge in the Baltics [BBC]. Meanwhile, the Flydubai pilot who thwarted an apparent mid-flight hijacking attempt spoke from his hospital bed, describing how he opened the cockpit door while being attacked, allowing passengers to subdue the assailant and prevent a catastrophe [BBC, ABC Australia, Globe and Mail].

top_stories.headline: EU Rejects US Diesel Export Ban Threat as Energy Standoff Escalates Ahead of Midterms
bullets: The US threatened to ban diesel exports unless EU nations release more strategic fuel reserves to help lower American fuel prices ahead of November midterm elections
EU officially 'fully rejected' the threat, with European Commission calling it damaging to trust in the US as a reliable partner
France proposed EU release of 50 million barrels of diesel alongside 50 million barrels of crude from IEA members; discussions ongoing among EU governments
Energy prices have spiked due to the ongoing US-Iran conflict, creating domestic political pressure for the Trump administration

sources.framing_note: Emphasized EU rejection and framed as US pressure on allies

sources.framing_note: Focused on diplomatic tensions and French-led response

top_stories.headline: Putin Warns Russia Will Use 'All Weapons' to Defend Kaliningrad Against NATO
bullets: President Putin stated Russia is prepared to use all weapons at its disposal if Kaliningrad comes under direct attack, while claiming Moscow is 'not threatening anyone'
Russia accused NATO of preparing to blockade its Baltic exclave, which borders Lithuania and Poland
Western allies have faced increased hybrid warfare incidents in recent months, including a Russian helicopter entering Polish airspace and a drone with explosives found at Leipzig airport
NATO responded by urging Russia to stop nuclear threats and emphasizing its defensive nature

sources.name: BBC Europe
sources.framing_note: Balanced reporting noting both Russian warnings and NATO's defensive posture

top_stories.headline: France Closes 400 Schools as Student Protests Turn Violent Nationwide
bullets: Around 400 of France's 3,700 secondary schools closed Friday on police orders, with many switching to online learning
Interior Ministry reported 1,949 arrests Thursday, with 305 police officers injured; 170 pupils and 65 education staff also hurt since protests began
Fires broke out at schools in Nantes and Rouen; staff at a Marseille school were splashed with petrol by protesters
Students are protesting staffing shortages, overcrowded classrooms, and deteriorating school conditions; university students joined demonstrations Thursday

top_stories.headline: Flydubai Pilot Describes Fighting for His Life to Save 170 Passengers During Cockpit Attack
bullets: Captain Smit Machchhar spoke from his Abu Dhabi hospital bed in a video call with Indian PM Modi, describing how he opened the cockpit door while still being attacked on the floor
The Boeing 737 Max plunged nearly 14,000 feet in under 30 seconds after the co-pilot allegedly stabbed Machchhar and attempted to crash the plane
Passengers, including one who used knowledge from the TV show 'Air Crash Investigation,' entered the cockpit, subdued the attacker, and pulled the plane out of its descent
Reserve pilots on board landed the aircraft safely at Tabuk, Saudi Arabia; Israeli PM Netanyahu hailed Machchhar as a 'true hero'

top_stories.headline: US Deploys Third Aircraft Carrier to Middle East as Iran War Enters Eighth Month
bullets: USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group departed San Diego for the Middle East, followed by the Makin Island Marine Expeditionary Unit with 2,000+ Marines
By end of November, three US aircraft carriers and two amphibious landing groups will be positioned near Iran
Deployments could involve 9,000-10,000 additional US troops in the region
Escalation comes one month before US midterm elections, with Trump's handling of the war deeply unpopular domestically
